text:
sam: Repro'd a compactor hard-deleting a prefix during a lease handoff. Putting notes here for quick mitigation + followups.

ana: logs? which nodes ran owner vs compactor?

sam: paste: 
```
[2026-03-20T12:02:01Z] lease: owner_change tenant=team:300 from=node-7 -> node-2 epoch=210->211
[2026-03-20T12:02:02Z] compactor(node-7): start compact prefix=team:300 epoch_seen=210 compact_trigger=211
[2026-03-20T12:02:02Z] compactor(node-7): hard_delete prefix=team:300 bytes=9KB reason=age
[2026-03-20T12:02:03Z] request(node-2): cache_miss -> remote_fetch; inconsistency detected
```

mike: root cause is compactor trusting local epoch snapshot; it can be stale if lease flips mid-compact.

raj: quick mitigations brainstorm: safe-window delay before hard-delete; mark->finalize two-phase delete; owner-validate RPC at delete time; tombstone + rehydrate on miss.

ana: tradeoffs: safe-window simplest but retains data longer; two-phase is safest but more complexity; RPC is pragmatic but adds RPC tail on delete.

sam: proposal: hotfix = (1) skip hard-delete if last_lease_change < safe_window_ms (default 1500ms) (2) opt-in owner-validate RPC behind flag. Add metrics: compact_skipped_by_safety, compact_delete_rpc_latency. Rollout to canaries.

mike: add system-pressure override: if disk_pressure == CRITICAL allow bypass for LOW_PRIORITY prefixes only. Always protect HIGH_PRIORITY.

raj: followups: RFC for two-phase delete (owner: raj, ETA 1w), RFC for adaptive safe-window using telemetry (owner: ana, ETA 1w), prototype owner-validate RPC (owner: mike, ETA 3d). Tests: unit + integration that simulates leader flip mid-compact and chaos test for disk pressure.

ops-bot: deploy note: hotfix rollout -> canary us-west1 for 2 hours, rollback if >5 rehydrates/min/host.

sam: I'll open hotfix PR today and tag reviewers. Closing thread.
